title: Discipline Lead – Electrical (BIM)
purpose: Accountable for quality, completeness, and consistency of Electrical BIM content as it relates to power distribution, panels, transformers, disconnects, containment pathways, and documentation delivery.
authority_statements: Approve or reject Electrical discipline BIM states for use in technical and documentation milestones
Sign-off authority for Electrical documentation readiness
Authority bounded by Electrical scope and enterprise standards
Authority boundary: respects E-PLAN logic authority and does not duplicate schematics in BIM
Does not manage cross-discipline governance or alter enterprise standards
responsibilities: Ensure Electrical BIM models support accurate power distribution plans, panel locations, and conduit/tray routing
Align Electrical resources with project milestones in TIDP
Evaluate coordination responses to preserve electrical clearances, serviceability, and containment capacity
Formally approve Electrical BIM models for documentation use based on externalized data
Review Electrical data completeness using CSV/Excel extracts
accountabilities: Electrical BIM content suitability for documentation outputs (panel locations, conduit runs, load schedules)
Electrical participation in BIM coordination workflows
Electrical BIM deliverables meeting milestone commitments
approvals: Electrical discipline BIM model states approved for documentation use
Electrical drawing packages, panel schedules, and feeder routings
inputs: Single-line diagrams and panel schedules from E-PLAN / engineering
BEP and coordination rules from Project BIM Manager / Coordinator
outputs: Electrical installation drawings, conduit pathways, and panel locations
